name: Session-handoff ORB — 1h break, low-churn wide-hold variant (session-anchored)
rationale: MECHANISM: identical session-handoff economics (overnight range re-priced at the US open by hedging/marking flow, faded by overnight range-traders until the flow wins) but on a 1h bar with a multi-day max hold. The literature's survival condition is that per-trade edge exceeds ~3x round-trip taker cost; the coarser bar and longer hold cut trade count sharply so each captured handoff move is large relative to fees. Entry: session-anchored opening-range breakout (setup.orb anchor='session') gated by adx (directional regime) and a positive ret_Nd handoff confirmation. Exit lets the trend run (wide time stop) with an adx-collapse signal exit. DISCONFIRMER: kill if anchor='rolling' nets the same (session timing curve-fit), or if the lower trade count masks a handful of lucky trades — must clear DSR 0.95 and BH-FDR net of fees, not just show a high raw mean.
catalyst: US session open range break held into the session trend
